mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (space_id, title, priority, due_date, is_done, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{title}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, false, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, space_id, title, priority, due_date, is_done, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM todos WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, due_date ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, is_done = #{isDone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
